# Purpose

State the shared purpose of the arrangement. Say what both
organisations aim to achieve together.

# Scope of cooperation

Name the activities the parties will cooperate on. State what each
party contributes.

# Resources and costs

State who provides what, and how shared costs split.

# Review and termination

State when the parties review the arrangement, and how either party
may end it.

# General

Record the remaining boilerplate: points of contact, notices, and
the non-binding nature of the understanding.
